simplify_redlines: simplify tracked changes in a Word document by merging adjacent w:ins and w:del elements from the same author
get_tracked_change_authors: get tracked change authors and their insertion/deletion counts from a Word document XML file
infer_author: infer the author of new tracked changes by comparing modified and original Word document XML files
merge_tracked_changes_in: merge adjacent tracked change elements of the same type and author within a Word paragraph or table cell
get_authors_from_docx: extract tracked change author counts from a .docx file by parsing its embedded word/document.xml
